attributes.board_name: Nebraska Board of Dentistry (DHHS Licensure Unit)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Acceptable continuing education courses as listed in 172 NAC 56
rules.audit_note: Random audit after renewal (notice by mail); keep CE documentation at least four years; do not send certificates unless requested.

topics.who: All professionals who prescribe controlled substances: 3 hours on opioids, incl. 0.5 hour on the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program

rules.notes: Licenses renewable March 1 of odd-numbered years; 30 hours in the 24 months before expiration. General anesthesia/deep/moderate sedation permit holders need at least 6 hours on anesthesia/sedation in the dental office. Inactive status available.
